answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a scarce stake and a unique proof-of-personhood beacon, as lantern that must burn continuously to signal liveness. Sybil resistance then hardens by requiring every new account to embed a distinct pigment of verifiable work history and graft onto the trust vine through sponsor attestations, so cloned identities cannot replicate the lineage. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
